title: North-West Frontier Province Irrigation And Drainage Authority Amendment Act 2005

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Irrigation And Drainage Authority Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 2006
ACT I OF 2006
North-West
Frontier Province Irrigation And Drainage Authority
(Amendment) Act 2005
An Act
further to amend the N.-W.F.P. Irrigation and Drainage Authority Act, 1997
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary,
18th January, 2006]
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province Irrigation and Drainage
Authority (Amendment) Act, 2005.
(2)
it shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Irrigation And Drainage Authority Amendment Act 2005
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of N.-W.F.P. Act No.V of 1997

ACT I OF 2006
ACT I OF 2006
North-West
Frontier Province Irrigation And Drainage Authority
(Amendment) Act 2005
An Act
further to amend the N.-W.F.P. Irrigation and Drainage Authority Act, 1997
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary,
18th January, 2006]
2. Amendment of section 4 of
N.-W.F.P. Act No.V of 1997.--In the North-West Frontier Province Irrigation
and Drainage Authority Act, 1997 (N.-W.F.P. Act No. V of 1997), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act; in section 4, in subsection (1), in clause (vii)-‑
(i) for the words "a
representative", the words "three representatives" shall be
substituted; and
(ii) for the words
"Farmers Organization", the word "farmers" shall be
substituted.
